premise: I sold my $220,000 condo and poured the proceeds into my son’s electric-bike franchise for a signed 49% stake, but he forged a gift letter, sold the entire business for $1.6 million, and mailed me a $200 gift card; I proved the forgery, won the franchise’s intellectual property, rebranded it as ‘Mama’s Revenge Rides’ now valued at $2 million, and hired him as a delivery driver required to wear a helmet reading ‘Perjurer on Probation’ on every shift.
